narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in southeastern Pennsylvania on the afternoon of September 23. Rainfall totals were as high as 2 to 3 inches.
ev: Minor flooding occurred along the East Branch of the Brandywine Creek along the border between West Bradford Township and East Bradford Township.
Main Street in Trainer was closed at West Seventh Street due to flooding.

A water rescue from a stranded vehicle took place near the intersection of Manor Road and Butterworth Road in Coatesville. Several roads in the Coatesville area were closed due to flooding, including Wagontown Road and Caln Road.
Minor flooding occurred along Cobbs Creek in Philadelphia.
River Road in Whitemarsh Township was closed at Harts Lane due to flooding.
The occupants of a vehicle were rescued from flood waters in Caln Township.
A water rescue from a vehicle took place near the intersection of West Oak Lane and Bartram Avenue in Darby Township.
A water rescue from a vehicle took place near Rutledge between Unity Terrace and Waverly Terrace.
A water rescue from a vehicle took place near the intersection of Marshall Road and Ashton Road in Upper Darby Township.
Rogers Lane in Nether Providence Township was closed due to flooding.
Minor flooding occurred along French Creek at Phoenixville.
Swedeland Road in Upper Merion Township was closed due to flooding.
The South Broad Street exit off Interstate 95 in Philadelphia was flooded and impassable.
Access ramps to Interstate 95 were closed due to flooding in the vicinity of Philadelphia International Airport.
A water rescue from a vehicle took place near the intersection of Industrial Highway and Stewart Avenue in the vicinity of Ridley Park.
Burmont Road in Drexel Hill was closed due to flooding.
Minor flooding occurred along Frankford Creek in Philadelphia.
The Poquessing Creek was out of its banks in Bensalem Township.
Swamp Creek Road in Gilbertsville was closed due to flooding.

A water rescue from a stranded vehicle took place near the intersection of Industrial Highway and Saville Avenue in Eddystone. Another water rescue from a vehicle took place near the intersection of Eddystone Avenue and East Fourth Street in Eddystone.
Several roads were closed in Chester due to flooding. A water rescue from a stranded vehicle took place near the intersection of East Fourth Street and Crosby Street.
